# Foundation Requirements Quality Checklist: 001-foundation

**Purpose**: Validate the *quality* of the 001-foundation requirements — completeness, clarity,
consistency, measurability, and coverage — before implementation. These are "unit tests for the
requirements," not tests of behaviour.
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (see also [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. A checked box
(`[x]`) means a reviewer has judged that the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied — it does
**not** mean implementation work is done. `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but never edits
these markers. Items are generated unchecked; only a reviewer checks them.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for *every* shop-owned data category that must be isolated, rather than only those named so far? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the complete set of administrative actions requiring admin authorization enumerated, with no other mutating action left unclassified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the full list of "required settings" specified, or is "required" left undefined so completeness cannot be judged? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the distinct credential-rejection reasons (missing, unknown, malformed, revoked, wrong kind) each specified as requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011/FR-020]
- [x] CHK005 - Is uniqueness of a service `code` within a catalog version stated as a requirement (not only an implied data-model detail)? [Gap, Spec §FR-016] — Resolved 2026-11-03: FR-016 now states codes unique per version.
- [x] CHK006 - Is there a requirement for how a catalog version is assigned and identified (format, ordering)? [Gap, Spec §FR-018] — Resolved 2026-11-03: FR-018 defines the deterministic `cat-NNN` format.
- [x] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for behaviour when the bootstrap administrative credential is absent or misconfigured at first start? [Gap, Spec §FR-020/FR-014] — Resolved 2026-11-03: FR-021 + SC-009 (fail-closed, no defaults).
- [ ] CHK008 - Are observability requirements for this slice either stated or explicitly deferred (e.g., structured logging without message text)? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK009 - Is "displayed exactly once ... stored only as a non-reversible fingerprint" precise enough to verify what is returned versus persisted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 - Is SC-004's target measurable given "standard laptop" is unquantified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — Resolved 2026-11-03 (analyze M1): SC-004 now names a reference laptop (≥4 cores, ≥8 GB).
- [ ] CHK011 - Are shop `slug` rules (allowed characters, length, case, immutability) specified at the requirement level, or only implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "named IANA time zone" constrained to a validated set, with behaviour specified for an invalid zone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is readiness's "expected schema (migrations) fully applied" defined measurably (how "expected" is determined)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013/§SC-008]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "administrative authorization distinct from a shop API credential" stated testably without prescribing a mechanism? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK015 - Can FR-004's build check be judged against a stated pass/fail condition (what it must assert)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 - Do FR-013 and SC-008 use the same definition of readiness (reachable AND migrated)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013/§SC-008]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do the Key Entities (Shop, Credential) and the Functional Requirements agree on every attribute (time zone, slug, last-used, status)? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities/§FR-005/FR-006/FR-010]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is "shop identity comes from the credential, never the body or path" stated consistently everywhere shop-scoped access is described? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK019 - Do the whole-cents rule (FR-017) and the catalog success criterion (SC-007) describe prices consistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017/§SC-007]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the three sample shop slugs (`rb-downtown`, `rb-northside`, `rb-lakeshore`) referred to consistently across scenarios, entities, and assumptions? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the term for the authenticating secret used consistently (e.g., "API credential" vs "API key") throughout the spec? [Ambiguity, Terminology] — Resolved 2026-11-03 (analyze T1): "API credential" set as canonical; stray "API key" normalized.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 - Does every P1/P2 user story (US1–US4) carry at least one objectively verifiable acceptance scenario? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1–US4]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are SC-001–SC-008 each tied to a verifiable condition free of implementation detail? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-008]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are acceptance scenarios defined for both rejection directions of FR-020 (shop key on an admin route; admin key on a shop route)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is there an acceptance scenario proving isolation holds when application-level filtering is absent (the direct-to-DB attack), not only through the API? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1/§FR-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 - Is the primary provisioning flow (create shop → issue credential → authenticate) specified end to end? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are alternate flows specified for multiple active credentials and rotation (issue-then-revoke)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007/FR-009]
- [x] CHK028 - Are recovery requirements defined for a partially-applied/pending migration at startup (refuse readiness only, or refuse to start)? [Recovery, Gap, Spec §FR-013] — Resolved 2026-11-03: FR-022 (migrate-before-serve; fail startup on incompatible/unpoliced schema).
- [ ] CHK029 - Are the out-of-scope boundaries (no AI, intake, orders, web form, email, retries) explicitly declared so reviewers can confirm no scope creep? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019/§Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 - Is duplicate-slug rejection stated as a requirement, not only an edge-case bullet? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is behaviour specified for a valid shop credential that references another shop's resource identifier? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is an empty-but-present required setting specified as equivalent to missing? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is catalog-load failure behaviour specified for both "not exactly twelve services" and fractional-cent prices? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016/FR-017]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are concurrency edge cases (shop-creation races, concurrent last-used updates) addressed or explicitly declared out of scope? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK035 - Are isolation requirements stated as database-enforced (not application-enforced) at the requirement level? [Security, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are secret-handling requirements (no committed secret, env-sourced, refuse-to-start) complete and independently testable? [Security, Spec §FR-014/FR-015]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are performance/operability expectations bounded to startup time, with throughput/scale explicitly out of scope for this slice? [NFR, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are privacy obligations for this slice addressed or explicitly scoped out (no customer PII exists yet)? [NFR, Assumption]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 - Is the dependency on the brief's authoritative catalog JSON documented, including interim behaviour until the real file is supplied? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is the time-zone default (a single named zone for the three samples) documented and flagged for confirmation rather than silently assumed? [Assumption, Spec §FR-006/§Assumptions]
- [x] CHK041 - After the FR-020 clarification, is the Assumptions section free of stale "operators are trusted, no separate auth" wording? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions/§FR-020] — Verified 2026-11-03: no unauthenticated-access wording remains; FR-023 + Assumptions assert auth on every protected route.

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK042 - Is any residual text that implies "readiness = reachability only" removed, so it does not conflict with the clarified reachable-AND-migrated rule? [Conflict, Spec §FR-013/§US3] — Verified 2026-11-03: FR-013/SC-008 now require reachable + migrated/compatible + configured + policed; liveness kept separate.
- [ ] CHK043 - Are the actors "the system", "operator", and "shop caller" disambiguated wherever responsibilities or permissions are assigned? [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK044 - Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme (FR/SC/US) established and used consistently so every item is traceable? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Scope selected: **Comprehensive foundation** (tenant isolation, credential/admin security, data
  model, operational, catalog). Depth: **Standard→gate** (the constitution treats isolation as a
  merge gate). Audience/timing: **PR reviewer**, before `/speckit-tasks` / implementation.
- Traceability: 41 of 44 items carry a spec reference or an explicit `[Gap]`/`[Assumption]`/
  `[Conflict]` marker (>80%); the few unreferenced items are cross-cutting (terminology, actor
  disambiguation, concurrency scope).
- These items test the *requirements*, not the system. Resolve `[Gap]`/`[Conflict]`/`[Ambiguity]`
  items by editing the spec (optionally via another `/speckit-clarify` pass) before implementation.
